verdict.rationale: Lovable explicitly supports plugging in MCP servers via custom MCP connectors and MCP registries, letting the app 'read from it as live context' from internal CRMs, private APIs, or third-party tools, and lets members pick servers from a registry to connect as chat connectors. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of connecting a third-party MCP server and using its tools in a live build, and more detail on tool invocation mechanics.
